raw_text: Farmer unions launched a large-scale march towards Delhi on Tuesday demanding legal guarantees for minimum support prices. Thousands of tractors assembled at multiple Punjab-Haryana border points including Shambhu and Khanauri. Social media platforms, particularly Telegram, were used extensively for mobilization including convoy routing, supply chain coordination, and barricade bypass strategies. Security forces deployed tear gas and water cannons at border points.
clean_text: Farmer unions marched to Delhi demanding legal MSP guarantee. Thousands of tractors at Punjab-Haryana border points. Telegram used for convoy routing, supply coordination, and barricade bypass strategies.
